 Frequently Asked Questions
 ELIGIBILITY
 To be eligible for the Youth Awards, you must:
 Be currently enrolled in high school and graduating in the spring of 2027
 Must have a minimum unweighted 3.0 GPA on a 4.0 scale or 7.5 on a 10.0 scale
 Must enroll at an accredited higher education institution in 2027-2028
 If selected, attendance to the virtual ceremony is mandatory
 If I am not a high school rising senior, can I apply for the Youth Awards? 
 No. Our Youth Awards program is only open to rising high school seniors who will be graduating high school in the Spring of 2027.
 If I'm currently enrolled in college or someone that does not qualify for a Youth Awards what other opportunities does the HHF offer? 
 We highly encourage students to join our Leaders On Fast Track (LOFT) Network. This is where we keep our members informed about opportunities on entry level jobs, scholarships & grant opportunities; students can also keep in touch with other young professionals with similar interests. 
 Can I apply if I am getting my GED? 
 Yes. If you are under the age of 21 and are receiving your GED, you are eligible for the Hispanic Heritage Youth Awards.
 What is an un-weighted GPA? 
 AP and IB classes give greater point weight to their grades which can result in GPAs over a 4.0. For the purpose of the Youth Awards, we look at un-weighted averages. This levels the playing field for students whose schools do not offer many AP or IB classes.
 What if my school does not use a 4 point grading scale? 
 Please calculate and convert your GPA to reflect the correct GPA on the 4.0 scale. You can use an online calculator here .
 I DON’T LIVE IN THE US CURRENTLY. CAN I STILL APPLY? 
 It is required that you reside in the US or its territories to apply. In the application, you will be asked for your US mailing address.
 Can I apply if I am home schooled? 
 Home schooling does not disqualify you from applying. As long as you are following an accredited home-schooling program or would be eligible to apply to an institution of higher learning for upcoming Fall semester next year then you still qualify.
 How do I apply to the Haz La U program? 
 The Haz la U program is a part of our Youth Awards. By applying to the Youth Awards, a student is also automatically applied for the Haz La U program.
 REQUIRED DOCUMENTS
 Letter of Recommendation
 Download Letter of Recommendation (PDF, 146kB)
 SCHOOL TRANSCRIPT
 Download School Transcript (PDF, 95kB)
 Essay Questions
 Download Essay Questions (PDF, 157kB)
 Are you submitting documents for a student applicant? 
 If you are submitting a Letter of Recommendation or School Transcript for a student applicant, please submit the documents here 
 CAN WE HAVE MULTIPLE LETTER OF RECOMMENDATIONS UPLOADED? 
 The portal will only accept a one letter of recommendation upload. It would not count against you for your letter of recommendation to talk about a specific category when applying to multiple categories.
 WHAT IS THE DEADLINE TO UPLOAD DOCUMENTS? 
 The deadline to upload documents is the same as the application deadline. All documents must be uploaded by November 1st, 2026 at 11:59:59 PM PST.
 THE PERSON SENDING MY LETTER OF RECOMMENDATION DOES NOT WANT TO SEND IT TO ME. HOW CAN THEY UPLOAD IT THEMSELVES? 
 In the “Required Documents” section of your application portal, you will be able to provide the email of the letter writer. It will also give you a link that you can send to the writer directly, we highly suggest that you reach out to the letter writer directly to make sure they received the email, to ensure that your application is complete. Please get in touch directly with the person uploading your documents to confirm they have all the information they need.
 APPLICATION
 What is the deadline to apply? 
 The deadline to apply is November 1st, 2026 at 11:59:59 PM PST.
 What regions are the Youth Awards open to? 
 The Youth Awards are open to all students within the United States and its territories, including American Samoa, Guam, Puerto Rico, and the Virgin Islands.
 What are the Youth Award Categories? 
 Current award categories include Community Service, Engineering, Entrepreneurship and Green, with additional categories being added throughout the awards season. Please check back regularly for our most current list of available categories.
 Can I apply to more than one category? 
 Yes. The more categories you apply to, the more chances you have of winning.
 WHAT IS MY YA ID (YOUTH AWARD ID) AND WHERE CAN I FIND IT? 
 Your Youth Award ID or YA ID is used internally to track your applications. You can find it in the upper right corner of your online application form above the Completion Status box, once you have completed your Personal Information section. Additionally, you can view it on the upper right corner of the PDF version of your completed applications.
 What is considered a complete application? 
 In order for your application to be complete we must have the following:
 Completed Youth Awards Application
 Submitted a Letter of Recommendation
 Submitted a School Transcript (official or unofficial)
 Your letter of recommendation and school transcript will need to be uploaded and your application submitted in order for it be considered complete.
 My school won't release school transcripts or letter of recommendation to me. What should I do? 
 We ask that letters of recommendation or school transcripts be submitted directly to us electronically here . We will not be able to accept documents sent through mail or email.
 If I have submitted an application online, can I go back and change the details? 
 No, you cannot change application details, but you can delete the application and submit another in its place. You can, however, still edit your Personal Information section at any point.
 Help! I’m getting the following error message How do I fix this? 
 Sometimes, a slow or faulty connection may cause this error to pop up. There is a simple solution, but we suggest that you save any answers you don't want to lose on a Word document or Google Doc to avoid loss of info. You will need to delete the category application (just once) and retry. After you delete the category app once and reopen the application, you will be able to continue filling it out and submit. Otherwise, reach out to us at [email protected] , and we can look into this.
 AWARDS
 When are Award Recipients Selected? 
 The regional award recipients will be selected and informed in January. Virtual Awards Ceremonies take place during February/March. You must agree to participate in the Virtual Award Ceremony to be eligible to receive your award.
 National Youth Award Recipients are announced in late March.
 Is this a one-time grant? 
 Yes, this is a one-time grant.
 How do we find out if we are chosen to receive a grant? 
 HHF will notify recipients at least two weeks prior to the virtual ceremony.
 What do Award Recipients Receive? 
 Youth Award recipients will receive up to a $4,000 educational grant depending on the selected category to use for their college education or to fund a community service effort.
 National Youth Award recipients will be celebrated at the National Youth Awards ceremony.
 What other educational grants can help me advance my education? 
 Visit our website and join our LOFT Network for more scholarship and educational grant information.
 DOs and DON’Ts
 DOs
 Do read all instructions.
 Do complete the application (Upload your letter of recommendation & school transcript).
 Do apply for more than one category.
 DON’Ts
 Don't skip any steps.
 Don't rush through your application.
 The Youth Awards were founded in 1998 by the Hispanic Heritage Foundation. Now entering their 28 th year, the Youth Awards honor high school seniors who excel in the classroom and community and for their excellence in various categories.
